decisions.reason: The exact-output swap and ETH refund rules apply only to the ETH-funded mint path; the Transak fiat-to-USDC purchase and fulfillment behavior remains unchanged.
The source changes conversion of supplied ETH into exactly 15 USDC, not the direct wallet-funded USDC approval and mint flow.
Obtaining exactly 15 USDC and refunding unused ETH does not alter the existing $15 mint price or its founder, affiliate, and prize-pool allocations.
The ETH swap and refund design does not change embedded-wallet provisioning or reward access for Transak fiat buyers.
The source decision does not request any FAQ or informational-copy change, and the existing $15 price explanation remains valid.
The source changes execution within the already enabled ETH payment path, not which payment methods are available or how users select them.
Primary-mint ETH conversion and refund behavior does not affect secondary-sale royalties, marketplace controls, or royalty allocation.
The exact-output ETH swap and unused-input refund rules do not change whether tips are offered or how tip amounts are selected.
The payment-contract change has no necessary effect on landing-page book-cover placement, size, cropping, or visibility.
The source decision does not require an About-page copy update, and its existing mint-price and product-mechanics descriptions remain valid.
Changing ETH swap execution and refund handling does not alter the requirement to render NFT metadata, images, or ebook assets.
The source decision does not change the landing-page hero's content, layout, payment-method disclosure, or stated $15 mint price.
